verdict.rationale: Law firms can plausibly ship self-serve document automation, so this story applies to Trilegal. The pack shows no interactive document-assembly tool: the only interactive offering is a DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool, which is an adjacent compliance self-assessment and not online assembly of real legal documents. The rest of the evidence covers advisory practices, rankings and knowledge content.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
